scope: All distinct XOR atom subsets of sizes 1,2,3 and all distinct signed modular atom subsets of sizes 1,2,3 were screened on the listed core coordinates.
Modular opposite atoms can cancel. Net identity decompositions are excluded; distinct decompositions with the same net transformation are deduplicated in the catalogue.
Z00 formal-core moves have no verified lift or state influence. A separate actual-witness input-word screen supplies exact schedule results for that family.
Universal support certificates use exact recurrence and small-sigma invertibility. State and condition observations cover only the four listed chart points or the one Z00 witness.
No sampled neutrality count is a probability, attack-cost reduction, bound, or evidence of independent retries. No collision is claimed.

semantics.atom_weight: Number of distinct primitive atoms in a minimal decomposition found among weights 1,2,3. XOR atoms are word/bit; modular atoms are word/bit/sign with the duplicate -2^31 omitted.
semantics.fixed_initial_xor: XOR the indicated base core word, hold all initial modular deltas fixed, derive late deltas from exact recurrence. This may XOR the partner by a different mask.
semantics.literal_common_modular: Add the same signed powers of two to both endpoints of each indicated pinned word. Every pinned coordinate difference is fixed.
semantics.literal_common_xor: XOR the same mask into both endpoints of each indicated pinned word, including late pins. Initial and late deltas may change and must satisfy every core closure.

state_conventions: S_t is the state after t rounds. Round t uses W_t. Da_t=a_right(S_t)-a_left(S_t) modulo 2^32. Condition bits compare Da_t to its frozen baseline value.
